title: Welcome, Sweetea
description:
Hello, Sweeteas!
This is a file I should have created a long time ago, but late is better than never, right? The focus here is conditioning you to my trance triggers, like Drop, Sleep, and another passive one. It’ll work for me, but also for anybody else you trust with your mind.
The more you listen, the deeper you drop. The easier. The quicker. Just like any other trigger training.
In addiction, there are suggestions that when certain triggers are combined, you lose all defense, all resistance, and become perfectly suggestible and receptive.
Now, listen to my voice and allow me to pull you down into a bottomless, cosmic trance.
For the full, unabridged description, please follow the Reddit link below. For a lower quality audio stream, use Soundgasm. For videos, we’ve got…Pornhub.
Click on the three “dots” to the right of the player and choosedownloadfrom the menu.If there is no “download” option, try a different browser, like Chrome or Firefox.
